name: steel-mcp
description: Give Claude a real Chrome browser in the cloud: read pages that block a plain fetch, capture screenshots and PDFs, and work through interactive sites.
long_description:
Steel runs a real Chromium in the cloud and hands it to Claude.

Most questions about a web page end with one stateless read that starts no browser at all. When a task needs interaction — signing in, filling a form, stepping through checkout — Claude opens an explicit browser session and drives it by clicking, typing and selecting against accessibility-tree references rather than guessing at pixel coordinates.

Pages that need JavaScript to render, sites that refuse scripted requests, content behind a login, and multi-step flows are all reachable. Screenshots and PDFs come back as links rather than megabytes of base64, and page reads stay inside a response budget, so a browsing task does not consume the whole context.

Everything read from a web page is fenced as untrusted data, and passwords and credentials are redacted before they reach a log.

steel_api_key.title: Steel API key
steel_api_key.description: Your key from https://app.steel.dev/settings/api-keys. It is sent only to Steel, and never to a self-hosted deployment.

steel_profile.title: Tool profile
steel_profile.description: "browse" exposes all fifteen tools. "scrape" exposes only the three stateless read tools, which never start a billed browser session.

tools.name: steel_scrape
tools.description: Read a web page as markdown or HTML. Starts no browser session.

tools.name: steel_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot, embed a bounded PNG preview when possible, and retain its attachment download link.

tools.name: steel_pdf
tools.description: Render a page to PDF and return a link to it.

tools.name: steel_session_create
tools.description: Start a browser session that can be interacted with, and show it inline where the host supports it.

tools.name: steel_session_release
tools.description: Shut a browser session down and stop the meter.

tools.name: steel_navigate
tools.description: Point an open browser session at a URL.

tools.name: steel_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current page as an accessibility tree with references that can be acted on.

tools.name: steel_find
tools.description: Locate one element on the current page without reading the whole page.

tools.name: steel_act
tools.description: Click, type, fill a form, select, hover, scroll, press a key, go back, or dismiss an overlay.

tools.name: steel_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for named text, a selector, or a URL before continuing.

tools.name: steel_session_diagnostics
tools.description: Read timestamped activity from a live or finished browser session without starting a new one.

tools.name: steel_session_handoff
tools.description: Pause while a person takes exclusive control of the same live browser, then resume after hand-back.

tools.name: steel_session_replay
tools.description: On an explicit watch or replay request, return a finished session's safe Steel dashboard link without starting a browser.

tools.name: steel_batch
tools.description: Run known reversible steps in one call; hand off before login, payment or final confirmation.

tools.name: steel_session_options
tools.description: Plan setup and discover safe profile/login metadata before creating a session.

tools.name: steel_session_live_view
tools.description: Return the connection details the inline session viewer needs. Returns no page content, and hosts hide it from the model.
